# Arav Innovations

> Enterprise IT Strategy, Full-Stack Engineering, Digital Marketing, Risk & Governance, and Staff Augmentation Globally.

## Overview
Arav Innovations is a multidisciplinary technology consulting and engineering firm operating across India (Gurugram) and the UAE (Dubai). We help enterprises, scale-ups, and organizations modernize technology infrastructure, build scalable web and mobile software, achieve regulatory compliance (DPDP, ISO 27001, GDPR), and accelerate digital market growth.

## Core Services
- [IT Strategy & Implementation](https://aravinnovations.com/services/it-strategy-implementation): Enterprise cloud roadmaps, architecture modernization, IT governance.
- [Web & Application Development](https://aravinnovations.com/services/web-app-development): Scalable React/Next.js web apps, microservices, cloud APIs, mobile platforms.
- [Digital Marketing & Brand Development](https://aravinnovations.com/services/digital-marketing-brand-development): Demand generation, brand positioning, performance marketing.
- [Risk, Compliance & Governance](https://aravinnovations.com/services/risk-compliance-governance): DPDP readiness, ISO 27001, GDPR compliance frameworks, SOC 2.
- [Audit & Technical Improvement](https://aravinnovations.com/services/audit-improvement): Architecture reviews, code audits, performance optimization blueprints.
- [Training & Staff Augmentation](https://aravinnovations.com/services/training-staff-augmentation): Pre-vetted senior engineering talent and capability building.
- [SEO Services](https://aravinnovations.com/services/seo-services): Technical crawlability, search architecture, organic growth engineering.
- [AI Portfolio](https://aravinnovations.com/services/ai-portfolio): Practical enterprise AI integration, agentic AI engines, workflow automation.
